items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: So she asked me if I'd come down and work with her.

ctx.x: It was like a -- it was like the Cotton Club. So she asked me if I'd come down and work with her. So Eddie Condon's was just across the street then. That street

was jumping, you know? I thought I would, so I left Rush to go down there and work with her. And then I had played one gig for the fella that owned the Celebrity Club in Freeport and he owned the one here. He had two clubs, one in Freeport and one -- so he used to tell me all the time, he says, "You know, I sure would like for you to form your own band and work in one of my clubs." So I said, "Well, I can't work in the one in Freeport," because I was living in New York then. So he says, "Well, this band I got in…
